{{Quote|I saved ''seeds'' from the breakfast fruit… Gonna plant them.|[[Tammia Hollusen]] to [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Tammia Hollusen's mother|mother]]|<ref name="Star Wars 1977 30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref>}}
[[File:Yarum_seed_Vis_Dict.jpg|thumb|right|Yarum seeds]]
'''Seeds''' were parts of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that could be found inside [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] and could be planted to create new plants.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 30" />

Particular seeds included:

*[[Galla seed/Legends|Galla seed]]
*[[Jakka seed]]<ref name="DM:SH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>
*[[Jekka seed]]<ref name="CN1">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>
*[[Molo seed]]
*[[Osera seed]]
*[[Yarum seed/Legends|Yarum seed]]

The phrase "a seed in a field of [[Bantha dung/Legends|bantha droppings]]" was used to describe something that was hard to find.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 17">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 17|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 17]]</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
The phrase "a seed in a field of [[Bantha dung/Legends|bantha droppings]]"<ref name="Rogue Squadron 17" /> is similar to the real-world idiom "a needle in a haystack."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/needle-in-a-haystack|text=a needle in a haystack|quote=something that is impossible or extremely difficult to find, especially because the area you have to search is too large|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250710231559}}</ref>
